_note: Short intro quest lines, one per unlock. Each starts when its `when` condition first holds (after the apprentice prologue), has 1-3 do-it steps with small rewards, is skippable and never blocks play. Conditions/checks are named predicates in js/engine/intros.js; view:<tab> and flag:<name> are generic. Only one line runs at a time; list order is priority. An ignored line steps aside quietly after expireDays so later intros are never held up.

lines.name: Rise of a Dynasty
lines.intro: Your family is now a Dynasty: other houses take notice. Feuds and wars are possible from here on.
lines.finale: The family has found its place among the great houses.

steps.title: Get any house to Friendly (gifts or house quests)

lines.name: Courtship & houses
lines.intro: A suitor has come calling, and other houses are watching.

lines.name: Enchanting
lines.intro: Mages of the family can bind enchantments into gear: a Rune Desk at home, or the Mage's Tower's Arcane Workshop.

steps.title: Place a Rune Desk (home) or build the Arcane Workshop

lines.name: Crafting
lines.intro: Someone in the family can craft now.

lines.name: Craft paths
lines.intro: The Crafters' Guild ranks you by craft path: Apprentice → Journeyman → Master → Grandmaster.
lines.finale: A true journeyman. Each rank opens one more path, and Master brings a specialty.

steps.title: Pick a main path (Main → 🔨 Craft paths)
Reach Journeyman in any path (XP in its skills)

lines.name: Food & meals
lines.intro: Your land can feed the family. Rations and the menu set morale.

lines.name: Minions
lines.intro: Hired hands can farm, gather, guard and adventure for you.

lines.name: Guilds
lines.intro: Guilds train members and open new paths.

steps.title: Have a member join any guild
